chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked: “Where did Ibrahim عليه السلام intend to sacrifice his son?” So he said:

“At the middle Jamrah. When Ibrahim عليه السلام intended to sacrifice his son, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام turned the knife over, drew the ram from the direction of Thabīr, drew the boy out from beneath it, and placed the ram in the place of the boy. And a call was made from the left side of Masjid al-Khayf:
“O Ibrahim, you have indeed fulfilled the vision. Indeed, thus do We reward the doers of good. Surely this was indeed the clear trial. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.”

Meaning, with a piebald ram: it walked in black, ate in black, looked in black, dropped dung in black, and urinated in black; a horned, mature male, and it had grazed in the meadows of Paradise for forty years.”

key_terms.الرُّؤْيَا: the vision seen by Ibrahim عليه السلام, which he fulfilled
key_terms.الْجَمْرَةِ الْوُسْطَى: the middle Jamrah, identified here as the location of the intended sacrifice
key_terms.بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ: with a great sacrifice, referring to the ram sent in ransom
key_terms.ثَبِيرٍ: Thabīr, the place from which the ram was brought
key_terms.رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ: the meadows of Paradise where the ram had grazed
key_terms.كَبْشٍ أَمْلَحَ: a piebald ram with distinctive markings
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ: Masjid al-Khayf, from whose left side the call was made

ai.seo_question: Where did Ibrahim عليه السلام intend to sacrifice his son, and what was the great sacrifice that replaced him?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that Ibrahim عليه السلام intended to sacrifice his son at the middle Jamrah, and it describes how Allah replaced the boy with a ram through Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام. It also cites the Qur'anic declaration of Ibrahim’s successful trial and identifies the “great sacrifice” as a special ram from Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2279 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked: "Where did Ibrahim (as) intend to sacrifice his son?"

Imam (as) said: "At the middle Jamrah. When Prophet Ibrahim (as) intended to sacrifice his son, Archangel Jibril (as) turned the knife over, pulled the ram from Mount Thabir, pulled the boy out from underneath, and placed the ram in the boy's place. Then a call came from the left side of the Mosque of Khayf: 'O Ibrahim, you have fulfilled the vision.

Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. This was indeed a manifest trial. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.'
It was a ram, piebald, walking in black, grazing in black, looking in black, defecating in black, urinating in black, horned, and strong.
It had grazed in the meadows of Paradise for forty years."
